name: Doro Wat
description: Traditional spicy chicken stew slow-cooked with berbere, clarified spiced butter (niter kibbeh), and served with a hard-boiled egg on injera.

name: Special Kitfo
description: Minced lean beef seasoned with mitmita and warm niter kibbeh. Served lightly warmed (mitin) with ayib (cottage cheese) and gomen (collard greens).

name: Beef Tibs
description: Tender tenderloin beef cubes sautéed with onions, rosemary, jalapeños, and garlic. Served hot in a clay pan.

name: Shiro Wat
description: Rich and savory chickpea flour stew simmered with garlic, onions, and local spices. Served bubbling hot with injera.

name: Yetsom Beyaynetu
description: A colorful sampler platter featuring misir wat, kik alicha, gomen, tikil gomen, and beet salad arrayed over fresh injera.

name: Special Firfir
description: Shredded injera sautéed in a rich berbere tomato sauce with spiced butter, topped with tender beef cubes and boiled eggs.

name: Shekla Tibs
description: Marinated beef strips stir-fried with berbere, chili peppers, and onions, served sizzling over a traditional charcoal-heated clay dish.

name: Spicy Misir Wat
description: Red split lentils simmered slowly in a fiery berbere, onion, and garlic sauce until thick and flavorful.

name: Kik Alicha
description: Yellow split peas stewed with turmeric, ginger, garlic, and sweet onions for a mild, comforting flavor.

name: Gomen besiga
description: Fresh Ethiopian collard greens stewed together with bone-in beef chunks, garlic, ginger, and green peppers.

name: Gomen (Collard Greens)
description: Finely chopped fresh collard greens steamed and sautéed with onions, garlic, and mild Ethiopian green peppers.

name: Bozena Shiro
description: Creamy chickpea shiro stew cooked with tender strips of marinated beef cubes, served steaming hot in a clay bowl.

name: Lamb Yebeg Alicha
description: Tender lamb cooked on the bone in a savory, mild turmeric broth seasoned with garlic, ginger, and rosemary.

name: Key Wat
description: Hearty beef stew slow-simmered in a dark red berbere sauce with caramelized onions, garlic, and cardamom.

name: Fosolia and Karot
description: Tender green beans and sweet carrot sticks sautéed with caramelized onions, garlic, and subtle Ethiopian herbs.

name: Ethiopian Spiced Coffee (Buna)
description: Traditionally roasted single-origin Ethiopian Arabica coffee brewed strong and served with fresh rue (tenadam).

name: Honey Tej
description: Traditional sweet honey wine fermented with gesho leaves, served in a classic glass flask (berele).

name: Bedele Premium Beer
description: Crisp and refreshing Ethiopian pale lager beer brewed from local barley.

name: Fresh Mango Juice
description: Thick, 100% natural organic fresh mango juice blended fresh to order.

name: Ethiopian Herbal Tea (Shai)
description: Black tea spiced with cinnamon bark, cardamom pods, and cloves.
